verdict.rationale: Moosend's own marketing copy says it puts repetitive tasks on autopilot with triggered emails and customer journeys, and it supports event-driven transactional emails. Together these show background automation that runs without manual action, but the evidence is a single homepage claim with no detail on how automations are built or run. Missing for 10: documentation of the workflow builder, trigger and condition types, scheduling or recurrence behavior, any AI-driven or agentic operation, and independent hands-on corroboration.
